text:
ITEM 1 | Rectangular wedge of baked dish with golden-brown, slightly charred top edge and reddish-orange sauce surface, layered cross-section showing darker brown crumbly filling; sits on left side of plate, roughly 9 cm long by 4 cm wide, about 2.5 cm thick, dense and firm | 110
ITEM 2 | Thick sliced tomato wedge with bright red glossy skin and pale pinkish-red flesh, juicy surface, sits against the wedge on the left side, roughly 5 cm across, about 1.5 cm thick | 40
ITEM 3 | Two triangular pieces of flatbread-style crust with golden-tan surface, orange-red tomato sauce spread on top and pale melted white cheese in patches with light browning, soft and slightly sagging, roughly 10 cm by 7 cm footprint, about 1.5 cm thick | 150
ITEM 4 | Tomato sauce layer visible on flatbread and wedge, bright orange-red, glossy and moist, spread thinly across the surfaces | 15
ITEM 5 | Cheese topping, pale white to light yellow, melted and partly browned in spots, soft and stretchy-looking, covering the central part of the flatbread pieces | 25
ITEM 6 | Two cooked green asparagus spears, bright green with slight darker tips, smooth firm surface with a faint sheen, each about 12 cm long and 0.8 cm thick, lying diagonally across the plate between the wedge and mushrooms | 30
ITEM 7 | Cluster of sautéed mushroom pieces, light to dark brown caps with glossy oily sheen, some halved showing pale stems and darker gills, slightly shriveled edges, piled in a small heap about 6 cm across and 2 cm high at lower right of plate | 60
